title: exacum nervosum
intro: Exacum nervosum, commonly known as the purple exacum, is a flowering plant species in the family Gentianaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various forms of medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Exacum nervosum involve its ability to exhibit sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-depressive properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Exacum nervosum include gentiopicrin, gentiin, and other flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
